entries.text: Finally I can search in plain English. Typed 'tasks overdue this week' and got exactly what I needed. Love this.
NovaMind is a massive upgrade. Replaced three manual searches with one query. My team is already using it daily.
Impressive for simple searches. Haven't tried complex filters yet. Will report back.
Searched for 'high priority tasks not yet assigned' and got completely wrong results. It ignored both the priority AND the assignment filter.
I used search results to prepare a client status report. Found out later the results were missing 8 tasks. Had to redo the whole report. This is a serious problem.
Search is painfully slow today. Took 20 seconds to return results. Unusable.
Complex queries with date ranges return wrong results. Single-word searches work fine. Something is broken with multi-condition logic.
@PurpleMerit NovaMind search is showing wrong results for filtered queries. Please fix ASAP.
Haven't hit any issues others are reporting. Works great for my use case — simple keyword-style queries in natural language.
Enterprise account here — Globex Corp. A project manager on my team used NovaMind search output to brief our board. The data was wrong. We need a formal explanation and a fix timeline.
Crashes seem less frequent after whatever you pushed today. Still nervous to use it for anything important.
The fix helped a little but complex queries with 3+ conditions still return wrong results at least 30% of the time.
Running 8 saved search workflows through NovaMind now. Saved my team 2 hours this week. Keep it stable and this becomes essential.
I now manually verify every search result before acting on it. That defeats the whole purpose of AI search.
Downgrading from 5 stars to 2. The AI search looked amazing at first but it silently gives wrong answers. You don't even know until you double-check everything manually.
Much faster today. The speed improvement is real. Still want the accuracy issue fixed but progress is visible.
I cancelled my subscription. The AI search was the reason I upgraded. It still gives wrong results on anything complex. Not paying for this.
Trust is the issue now. Even when results look right I spend extra time verifying. That extra time cancels out any time I saved using natural language.
Best feature PurpleMerit has shipped in years. For my workflow — simple team queries — it works perfectly every time. Please don't roll it back.
Hey @PurpleMerit — NovaMind still returns stale results after the hotfix. Created a task 10 minutes ago, search doesn't find it.
New problem since yesterday — tasks I created today don't show up in search at all. The old keyword search was instant. This is a regression.
Three issues in one week: slow on Day 5, wrong results ongoing, now missing results. Hoping the team gets on top of this.
I manage a 15-person team. NovaMind is genuinely saving us time when it works. Please just fix the accuracy and keep it running.
Three colleagues and I all hit wrong results today on different types of queries. This is not an edge case — it's a fundamental accuracy problem.
Idea: can you show a confidence score next to search results so I know when to verify manually? Would make the product usable even with current accuracy.

summary.new_issue_day7: Stale/missing results — indexing lag after hotfix (F20, F21)
